note: Frozen BEFORE any evaluation run. Thresholds and decision rules here are chosen on the 20% training prefix or stated a priori; no evaluation-window tuning. Sweeps on evaluation windows are labelled sensitivity (not selection).

primary_metric.name: pooled_macro_f1
primary_metric.definition: concatenate y_true and y_pred over all evaluation windows of one (dataset, method, seed) run, then macro-F1
primary_metric.secondary: per_window_macro_f1 (mean of per-window macro-F1); always labelled secondary; never mixed with pooled in one table

protocol.window_sizes_note: 5g_nr processed stream is already window-level (window_size=1 sample per window); the sample-equivalent variant uses 500 packets per window per the 9B loader

hypothesis_decision_rule.rule: a hypothesis is SUPPORTED only if the day-block bootstrap 95% CI (24 blocks for UGR'16, regime visits for the others) of the paired difference excludes zero in the predicted direction; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED, or INCONCLUSIVE when n is too small
hypothesis_decision_rule.seed_floor: seed-level exact Wilcoxon over 5 seeds has minimum two-sided p = 0.0625; when a verdict rests on this floor the CI is the deciding evidence and this is stated

detector_wiring_fix: v2/detectors_v2.py (A8): river update() returns None; EDD/EDMA logic fixed. Prefix-chosen settings are the defaults above; sweeps are sensitivity (not selection).
rapt_floor_note: 0.97 was set in Final_Experiments/config.py as an absolute rolling-accuracy floor; git history check in E1
